description: Summarize Gong call transcripts into short summaries + action items using an OpenAI-compatible LLM.

outputs.description: Upstream DataFrame enriched with summary and action_items columns

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with a transcript column

llm_provider.label: LLM Provider
llm_provider.description: LLM provider. Currently supports 'openai' and OpenAI-compatible endpoints via base_url.

model.label: Model
model.description: Model identifier passed to the provider

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the LLM provider API key

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Override the OpenAI-compatible base URL (Azure OpenAI, LiteLLM, local vLLM, etc.)

transcript_column.label: Transcript Column
transcript_column.description: Name of the column containing the flattened transcript text

summary_column.label: Summary Column
summary_column.description: Name of the output column to write the summary text into

action_items_column.label: Action Items Column
action_items_column.description: Name of the output column to write the action items list into

skip_empty.label: Skip Empty
skip_empty.description: If true, rows with empty transcript are skipped (empty outputs).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current date partition (time partitions).
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current static/dynamic partition key.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)
deps.label: Deps

name: Gong Call Summary Asset
